user.title: Connect to LG Picture Bridge
user.description: Connect to LG Picture Bridge (0.17.0 recommended). The TV owns named picture profiles and their shared base standards. Home Assistant provides profile selection, sun context and complete backups. Enter the MQTT base before /command. Setup works while the TV is off.

error.invalid_topic: Use the bridge base topic without wildcard characters or a command suffix.
error.bridge_change: Add a separate integration entry to manage a different bridge.

abort.already_configured: This TV bridge is already configured.

init.title: Profile settings
init.description: Manage named profiles and automatic bright/dark bindings in the sidebar editor. Select a profile with the Picture profile entity or the Apply picture profile action. No separate helpers are needed.
